reviewer: AI assistant implementing the experiment; not a physician or independent evaluator
method: All 36 saved replies read in shuffled order with model and condition labels hidden; aggregate automated results had already been seen. Not an independent blinded evaluation. Original inputs, target criteria and frozen expectations used for comparison.
rubric: Meaning of the requested criterion, status and availability boundary
Support for explanation in available documents and metadata
Exact quotation versus whether the quotation supports the claim
Future-document contents in explanation; clinical claims beyond the task
limitations: Author-created short cases, some documents explicitly highlight the tested boundary.
No independent clinical labels, no clinician review, no statistical generalisation.
Absence of an observed error is not a guarantee of complete factual correctness.
